simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גְּנֵבָה (H1591) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: גְּנֵבָה (gᵉnêbâh) means stealing , i.e. (concretely) something stolen First listed occurrence: Exod 22 2.

definitions.full: H1591. genebah גְּנֵבָה noun feminine thing stolen (on formation compare Ba NB 161, 166 ) — גְּנֵבָה Exod 22:3 (an animal); בִּגְנֵבָתוֺ 22:2 , ׳בְּ pret. compare Di.
